verses.37:11: فَٱسۡتَفۡتِهِمۡ أَهُمۡ أَشَدُّ خَلۡقًا أَم مَّنۡ خَلَقۡنَآۚ إِنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰهُم مِّن طِينࣲ لَّازِبِۭ

meaning: The root لزب (lazib) describes something adhering, fixed, or constant, like cohesive clay. It can also mean indispensable or necessary.
en_note: Statistically derived from translation co-occurrence, not a lexical definition. Highlighting only.
